about: Every sentence and button label the game shows in a taught language, grouped by feature; a phrase's id is 'group.key' (shop.success). Each phrase has one line per language code of data/languages.json. {name} marks a value the game fills in; {name:form} asks the language's rules module for a grammatical form of a word (forms: scripts/language/language_rules.gd FORMS), and 'slots' names the word category that may fill it, so tools/language_check.gd can render it with every such word. Optional 'note' explains a phrase. Game code never joins words into a sentence: add a phrase here. See docs/guides/ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW_PART1.md#vocabulary-data-procedure.

term_meaning.note: Shown in the native language after a coloured word of the language being learned in the dialogue box (shop_order_panel.gd, tapped or always for amounts): its meaning.

finish_first.es: Primero hay que terminar la otra tarea.
finish_first.note: Any NPC while another activity is running (data/activities.json: one activity at a time). Neutral register: said by tú- and usted-speaking NPCs.

en.note: A language's name, written in each language (Settings and the HUD). Every language code of data/languages.json needs one.

title.note: The game's short name (user, 16 Nov 2026: the game is "Bon Adventure: Little Town of Words", never translated). The title page shows the logo picture (assets/branding/) and this only if the picture is missing; also the speaker of the new-version question (web_resume.gd). Other lines that name the game (app.update_ready, the tutorial's welcome) use "Bon Adventure" too.

play.note: The Play button on the title screen (user, 13 Nov 2026: replaces "Tap to start").

getting_ready.note: Loading screen, last part: the town is built and the first views are being drawn so play starts smoothly.

last_update.note: Small line in a corner of the title, character and loading screens: when this build was exported, month-day and 24-hour time ({date} 11-15, {time} 19:25; scripts/core/build_stamp.gd; user, 15 Nov 2026). Not shown when the game runs from the project.

graphics_lost.note: Web: the browser dropped the game's graphics (WebGL context lost); the page shows this and reloads straight back to the same spot (web_resume.gd, 14 Nov 2026).

tap_to_reload.note: Web: under graphics_lost when the graphics were lost three times in two minutes; the page waits for a tap instead of reloading again by itself.

graphics_back.en: All set! You're right where you left off.
graphics_back.zh: 好了！你回到剛才的地方了。
graphics_back.note: Web: the HUD message after the page reloaded because the graphics were lost.

update_ready.es: Hay una versión nueva de Bon Adventure. ¿Actualizar ahora? Sigues donde estás.
update_ready.en: A new version of Bon Adventure is ready. Update now? You'll stay right where you are.
update_ready.zh: Bon Adventure 有新版本了。現在更新嗎？你會回到這裡。
update_ready.note: Web: a new build was published while the player is in the town (web_resume.gd, 15 Nov 2026). Shown in the native language when the player is free, with app.update_now / common.reply_no. Before the town has loaded the game switches to the new build without asking.

new_profile.note: Profile select tile and the first onboarding page (up to 3 local profiles, profile_manager.gd).

found_saves.es: Encontramos tu progreso guardado. Elige un personaje para conservarlo.
found_saves.en: We found your saved progress. Pick a character to keep it.
found_saves.zh: 我們找到了你的進度。選一個角色就能保留。
found_saves.note: First launch after the profiles update: the old saves move into this profile.

languages.note: The language page of a new character (app_screens.gd). Like every screen before the town it shows in data/languages.json's native language (English, user decision 14 Nov 2026).

languages_hint.es: Toca un idioma en cada fila.
languages_hint.en: Tap one language in each row.

i_speak_hint.note: Beside "I speak": what the native language is used for.

i_learn_hint.note: Beside "I want to learn": what the foreign language is used for.

explore.note: Start screens' language page (user, 18 Nov 2026): a choice under the two language rows; ticked, the new player starts with "Show everything in my language" on (GameSettings.set_native), nothing else.

profile_progress.note: Under a saved character on "Pick your character": the language it learns and the words it has found (13 Nov 2026: the profiles have no names any more, so two saves of the same character need this).

delete_confirm.es: ¿Borrar a {name}? Se perderá todo su progreso.
delete_confirm.en: Delete {name}? All of this player's progress will be lost.
delete_confirm.zh: 刪除{name}？這位玩家的進度會全部消失。

title.note: The Settings window (Esc with nothing open, or the gear button). Its labels show in the native language.

native_mode.note: Native mode checkbox (user decision, 7 Nov 2026): every text in the native language; no practice is recorded while it is on.

open.note: Tooltip of the gear button on the HUD.

switch_profile.note: Settings button (PWA phase 3): back to the profile select.

show_fps.note: Settings checkbox: the perf readout (perf_readout.gd; also ?perf=1 on the web or F3). Not saved.

follow_camera.note: Settings checkbox (14 Nov 2026): walking sideways turns the view (player_controller.gd follow_view()). On by default.

volume_master.note: Settings sound sliders (24 Nov 2026; game_settings.gd VOLUME_BUSES): every sound.

volume_effects.note: World, ambience and button sounds (SFX, Ambience and UI buses).

volume_voice.note: The spoken words (the Voice bus, docs/guides/VOICE.md).

greeting_needs_help.en: Hi! Do you have a moment to help me?
greeting_needs_help.zh: 你好！你有時間幫我一下嗎？

greeting_no_help.en: I don't need help right now, thanks!
greeting_no_help.zh: 我現在不需要幫忙，謝謝！

another_order.en: Can you help me with another order?
another_order.zh: 你可以再幫我買一張單嗎？
another_order.note: Asked after a finished order while the session has more orders (test launcher rounds), with Yes / Not now.

order_intro.es: ¡Gracias! Necesito estos productos. Búscalos en la tienda, págalos en la caja y tráemelos.
order_intro.en: Thank you! I need these items. Find them in the store, pay at the till and bring them to me.
order_intro.zh: 謝謝你！我需要這些貨品。請在店裏找到，在收銀處付款，再拿來給我。
order_intro.note: Since 21 Nov 2026 (user) the order is paid at the till before it is brought back.

return_to_clerk.es: Muy bien. Por favor, vuelve con {clerk:definite}.

price_each.note: A product's price on the shopping list and in the basket (21 Nov 2026); {price} is digits ($1.25).

quit_confirm.en: Are you sure you want to stop shopping?

success.es: ¡Perfecto! Es todo lo que necesitaba. ¡Muchas gracias!
success.en: Perfect! That's everything I needed. Thank you so much!
success.zh: 太好了！我需要的都齊了。非常感謝！

retry_missing.es: Todavía me falta: {missing}. ¿Puedes intentarlo otra vez?
retry_missing.en: I'm still missing: {missing}. Can you try again?
retry_missing.zh: 我還缺少：{missing}。你可以再試一次嗎？

final_reveal.es: No pasa nada. Te ayudo: {pairs}. ¡Muchas gracias!
final_reveal.en: No worries. Let me help: {pairs}. Thank you so much!
final_reveal.zh: 不要緊，我來幫你：{pairs}。非常感謝！

leave_goodbye.es: ¡Qué pena que te vayas! Espero verte pronto.
leave_goodbye.en: Sorry to see you go! Hope to see you soon.
leave_goodbye.zh: 你要走了，真可惜！希望很快再見到你。

item_count.note: One order line. Quantities are numbers, not plurals (plural forms are later work).

word_pair.note: Final reveal: the foreign word, then its native meaning.

correct.en: Perfect! That's the exact amount. Thank you!

wrong.es: Mmm, esa no es la cantidad correcta.
wrong.en: Hmm, that's not the right amount.

goodbye.es: Muy bien. ¡Que tenga un buen día!
goodbye.en: All right. Have a nice day!
goodbye.zh: 好的。祝你有美好的一天！

quit_confirm.en: Are you sure you want to leave?

no_request.es: Por ahora no hay nada que pagar. ¡Gracias!
no_request.en: There's nothing to pay right now. Thanks!
no_request.zh: 現在沒有要付的錢。謝謝！
no_request.note: The cashier is not offering rounds this visit (data/activities.json chance).

grab_basket.es: ¡Hola! Tome una canasta junto a la puerta para hacer sus compras.
grab_basket.en: Hello! Take a basket by the door to do your shopping.
grab_basket.zh: 你好！請在門口拿一個籃子去購物。
grab_basket.note: Talking to the cashier without a basket (21 Nov 2026).

check_list.es: Mmm, esto no es lo que dice su lista. Por favor, revísela.
check_list.en: Hmm, this isn't what's on your list. Please check it.
check_list.zh: 嗯，這和你的清單不一樣。請再看看。
check_list.note: The order's basket does not match its list; from the second check on, check_missing / check_extra follow.

basket_back.es: Me quedo con la canasta. ¡Que tenga un buen día!
basket_back.en: I'll take the basket. Have a nice day!
basket_back.zh: 籃子交給我吧。祝你有美好的一天！

put_back.es: Muy bien, yo lo devuelvo todo. ¡Hasta pronto!
put_back.en: All right, I'll put everything back. See you soon!
put_back.zh: 好的，我會把東西全部放回去。下次見！
put_back.note: The basket was given back without paying: the shopping is called off.

pay_first.es: ¡Espere! Por favor, pague en la caja antes de salir.
pay_first.en: Wait! Please pay at the till before you leave.
pay_first.zh: 等等！請先在收銀處付款再離開。
pay_first.note: The shop door holds back a player carrying an unpaid basket (21 Nov 2026).

rack_first.es: Por favor, deje la canasta en su sitio antes de salir.
rack_first.en: Please put the basket back before you leave.
rack_first.zh: 離開前請把籃子放回原處。

empty_first.es: Primero saque los productos de la canasta
empty_first.en: Take the items out of the basket first
empty_first.zh: 請先把貨品從籃子裏拿出來

stop_confirm.en: Stop shopping and put everything back?
stop_confirm.zh: 不買了，把東西全部放回去嗎？

title.note: Poster headers: the title in the language shown (L toggle), then in the other taught language.

person.note: A family poster card: one person's word ('la prima' / 'cousin').

me.note: The person the family tree poster is centred on.

month_row.note: Months poster row: the month's number (digits), then its name.

verbs_title.note: Warehouse reception poster of the 22 action verbs.

places_title.note: Warehouse reception poster of position words (on top of, under, behind…).

zone_in.note: Painted on the warehouse hall floor by the loading door: where goods arrive.

zone_out.note: Painted on the warehouse hall floor: where goods leave.

describe_title.note: Warehouse reception poster of colors, big/small and heavy/light.

relative_title.zh: 甚麼時候？昨天、今天和明天
relative_title.note: Airport poster of relative days, weeks, months, years and intervals (flight game).

calendar_title.note: Airport poster of weekdays and clock expressions (flight game).

airport_title.note: Airport poster of airport words, left of the door (flight game).

countries_title.note: Airport poster of the 12 destination countries with their flags, left of the door (flight game).

tastes_title.note: Alta Cocina poster: the five tastes and three temperatures with the restaurant game's icons (6 Nov 2026).

ingredients_title.note: Alta Cocina poster above the entrance: the ingredient icons.

menu_title.note: Alta Cocina menu board: the restaurant game's dishes.

evidence_title.note: Evidence room poster (8 Nov 2026): each verb over the two properties it reveals.

ramon.note: The warehouse boss, a lion plush (man). Speaker name in the dialogue box.

greeting.es: ¡Hola! Soy Ramón, el jefe. Hoy llegaron muchos paquetes. ¿Me ayudas a ordenar el almacén?
greeting.en: Hi! I'm Ramón, the boss. Lots of packages arrived today. Will you help me organize the warehouse?
greeting.zh: 你好！我是拉蒙，我是老闆。今天到了很多包裹。你可以幫我整理倉庫嗎？

not_now.es: Ahora no hay trabajo. ¡Vuelve más tarde!
not_now.en: There's no work right now. Come back later!
not_now.zh: 現在沒有工作。請稍後再來！
not_now.note: Ramón is not offering the game (data/activities.json chance).

intro.es: Este es el almacén. Hay cinco tareas. Lee la tarjeta de arriba. Si necesitas una pista, pulsa ? o habla conmigo.
intro.en: This is the warehouse. There are five tasks. Read the card at the top. If you need a hint, press ? or talk to me.
intro.zh: 這是倉庫。一共有五個任務。請看上面的卡片。需要提示的話，按？或者和我說。
intro.note: Said in the minigame copy, right after the fade in.

task_again.note: Talking to Ramón during the game repeats the current task. {task} is the task sentence in the same language.

leave_confirm.es: ¿Quieres salir del almacén? Las tareas no se guardan.
leave_confirm.en: Do you want to leave the warehouse? The tasks won't be saved.
leave_confirm.zh: 你想離開倉庫嗎？任務不會保存。
leave_confirm.note: Leaving early always asks first (user decision, 5 Nov 2026).

complete.es: ¡Terminamos! Gracias por tu ayuda. ¿Me ayudas otra vez?
complete.en: We're done! Thanks for your help. Will you help me again?
complete.zh: 完成了！謝謝你的幫忙。你可以再幫我一次嗎？
complete.note: All tasks done (data/activities.json progress); outside, with Yes (warehouse.play) / No (common.reply_no) to play again (user decision, 8 Nov 2026).

thing_box.note: Things in Warehouse Worker tasks are ready-made noun phrases (no {slot:form}). A box is named by colour and size (8 Nov 2026: three fixed sizes) from color_f_* and box_size_*. Spanish contractions (de el → del, a el → al) come from rules_es.gd polish().

thing_box_plain.note: A box by colour only, where its size would give the answer away (which box is bigger / smaller).

box_size_big.note: Inside la caja …, so feminine where the form changes.

color_f_red.note: A colour inside a feminine noun phrase (la caja, la maleta).

color_m_blue.note: A colour inside a masculine noun phrase (el barril).

thing_table.note: The one table of the hall (14 Nov 2026; before, la mesa de trabajo beside a measuring table).

thing_measure_table.note: The plate at the foot of the upright ruler (8 Nov 2026), in hints: pon … en la base de la regla.

thing_rack_A.note: A whole rack with its letter plate.

thing_zone_in.note: The floor areas painted ENTRADA / SALIDA (posters.zone_in / zone_out).

place_on_top.note: Places complete 'Pon {item} {place}.' The zh lines start with 在 (把…放在…).

place_front.note: The reference stands in a wall bay: front = away from the wall, behind = toward it, left / right as seen facing it from the front.

place_boss_front.note: Ramón's own front: where give-me tasks end (8 Nov 2026).

place_onto.note: place_on inside a placing instruction (Pon / Deja / Mueve …): English 'onto'; answers and hints use place_on.

place_at_top.es: en la parte de arriba de {ref}
place_at_top.note: {ref} is a rack: its top shelf.

place_at_bottom.es: en la parte de abajo de {ref}
place_at_bottom.note: {ref} is a rack: its bottom shelf.

place_up.note: The middle or top shelf of any rack.

place_down.note: The bottom shelf of any rack.

place_in.note: Only in answers to ¿Dónde está…? (a floor area).

task_put.note: Task sentences of the generator (warehouse_tasks.gd). Ramón says tú; nouns are repeated instead of clitic pronouns.

task_lift.note: Two verbs in one task (user, 8 Nov 2026): done when it is put there.

task_pick_up.en: Pick up {item} from the floor and put {it} {place}.
task_pick_up.zh: 從地板上撿起{item}，然後把{it}放{place}。

task_look_for.es: Busca {item} en el almacén y pon{it} {place}.
task_look_for.en: Look for {item} in the warehouse and put {it} {place}.

task_find.note: No 'somewhere in the warehouse' tail (user, 8 Nov 2026: too long).

it_f.note: The pronoun of a feminine thing (la caja, la maleta) after a command: levántala.

it_m.note: The pronoun of a masculine thing (el barril, el paquete): levántalo.

task_weigh.es: Pesa {item} en la báscula y dime cuánto pesa.
task_weigh.en: Weigh {item} on the scale and tell me how much it weighs.
task_weigh.zh: 用磅稱{item}，然後告訴我它有多重。

task_measure.es: Mide {item} con la regla y dime cuánto mide.
task_measure.en: Measure {item} with the ruler and tell me how tall it is.
task_measure.zh: 用間尺量{item}，然後告訴我它有多高。
task_measure.note: The copy's measuring device is an upright ruler on a base plate (user, 8 Nov 2026): it reads a thing's height.

task_where.en: Find {item} and tell me where it is.
task_where.zh: 找{item}，然後告訴我它在哪裡。
task_where.note: Answered by talking to Ramón (three choices).

kilos.note: Answer choices; {n} is written in digits.

lift_then.note: Said when the first half of a two-verb task is done (it is picked up).

wrong_place.es: Mmm, {item} no está en el lugar correcto. ¿Quieres intentarlo otra vez, o te digo qué salió mal?
wrong_place.en: Hmm, {item} isn't in the right place. Do you want to try again, or shall I tell you what went wrong?
wrong_place.zh: 嗯，{item}不在對的地方。你想再試一次，還是要我告訴你哪裡出錯了？
wrong_place.note: A wrong attempt (user decision, 5 Nov 2026): try again or be shown what went wrong. No first-try counting.

wrong_thing.es: Mmm, eso no es {item}. ¿Quieres intentarlo otra vez, o te digo qué salió mal?
wrong_thing.en: Hmm, that isn't {item}. Do you want to try again, or shall I tell you what went wrong?
wrong_thing.zh: 嗯，那不是{item}。你想再試一次，還是要我告訴你哪裡出錯了？

wrong_answer.es: Mmm, esa no es la respuesta. ¿Quieres intentarlo otra vez, o te digo qué salió mal?
wrong_answer.en: Hmm, that's not the answer. Do you want to try again, or shall I tell you what went wrong?
wrong_answer.zh: 嗯，答案不對。你想再試一次，還是要我告訴你哪裡出錯了？

hint_place.es: Mira: {item} tiene que estar {place}. Te marco el lugar en verde.
hint_place.en: Look: {item} has to be {place}. I'm marking the spot in green.
hint_place.zh: 看：{item}要放{place}。我用綠色標出了位置。

hint_number.en: Look at the screen: it says {answer}.

hint_where.es: Mira: {item} está {place}. Te marco el lugar en verde.
hint_where.en: Look: {item} is {place}. I'm marking the spot in green.
hint_where.zh: 看：{item}{place}。我用綠色標出了位置。

thing_box_at.note: A box named by where it is (only when no other box is there).

task_color.en: Look for {item}. What color is it?
task_color.note: Answered by talking to Ramón (three colours).

color_red.note: Answers about a box (la caja), so feminine.

task_what.es: Ve a ver qué hay {place} y dímelo.
task_what.en: Go and see what is {place}, then tell me.
task_what.zh: 去看看{place}有甚麼，然後告訴我。
task_what.note: Exactly one thing is there; answered by talking to Ramón.

task_heavier_box.es: Pesa {a} y {b} en la báscula. ¿Qué caja es más pesada?
task_heavier_box.en: Weigh {a} and {b} on the scale. Which box is heavier?
task_heavier_box.zh: 用磅稱{a}和{b}。哪個紙箱比較重？
task_heavier_box.note: Ramón asks once both have been on the scale alone.

task_lighter_box.es: Pesa {a} y {b} en la báscula. ¿Qué caja es más ligera?
task_lighter_box.en: Weigh {a} and {b} on the scale. Which box is lighter?
task_lighter_box.zh: 用磅稱{a}和{b}。哪個紙箱比較輕？

task_bigger_box.es: Mide {a} y {b} con la regla. ¿Qué caja es más grande?
task_bigger_box.en: Measure {a} and {b} with the ruler. Which box is bigger?
task_bigger_box.zh: 用間尺量{a}和{b}。哪個紙箱比較大？

task_smaller_box.es: Mide {a} y {b} con la regla. ¿Qué caja es más pequeña?
task_smaller_box.en: Measure {a} and {b} with the ruler. Which box is smaller?
task_smaller_box.zh: 用間尺量{a}和{b}。哪個紙箱比較小？

hint_weights.es: Mira la pantalla: {a} pesa {x} kilos y {b} pesa {y} kilos.
hint_weights.en: Look at the screen: {a} weighs {x} kilos and {b} weighs {y} kilos.
hint_weights.zh: 看看屏幕：{a}重{x}公斤，{b}重{y}公斤。

hint_sizes.es: Mira la pantalla: {a} mide {x} centímetros y {b} mide {y} centímetros.
hint_sizes.en: Look at the screen: {a} is {x} centimeters tall and {b} is {y} centimeters tall.
hint_sizes.zh: 看看屏幕：{a}高{x}厘米，{b}高{y}厘米。

hint_look.es: Mira: te marco en verde lo que hay {place}.
hint_look.en: Look: I'm marking in green what is {place}.
hint_look.zh: 看：我用綠色標出了{place}的東西。

ask_hint.note: Choice when talking to Ramón during a game (8 Nov 2026); the same hints as the card's ? button.

hint_button.note: Tooltip of the task card's ? button.

hint_area.note: First hint: the part of the hall (warehouse.area_*).

hint_bring.es: Pista: ven a donde estoy yo con {item}.
hint_bring.en: Hint: come over to me with {item}.

hint_device.es: Pista: pon {item} en {ref} y mira la pantalla.
hint_device.en: Hint: put {item} on {ref} and look at the screen.
hint_device.zh: 提示：把{item}放在{ref}上，然後看看屏幕。

hint_compare.es: Pista: pon {a} en {ref}, después {b}, y mira la pantalla cada vez.
hint_compare.en: Hint: put {a} on {ref}, then {b}, and look at the screen each time.
hint_compare.zh: 提示：先把{a}放在{ref}上，再放{b}，每次都看看屏幕。

hint_mark_place.es: Mira: te marco el lugar en verde.
hint_mark_place.en: Look: I'm marking the place in green.
hint_mark_place.zh: 看：我用綠色標出了那個地方。

hint_mark_trolley.es: Mira: te marco el carrito en verde. Agárralo con E.
hint_mark_trolley.en: Look: I'm marking the trolley in green. Grab it with E.
hint_mark_trolley.zh: 看：我用綠色標出了推車。按E抓住它。

hint_trolley_push.es: Pista: ponte detrás del carrito, agárralo con E y empújalo con W.
hint_trolley_push.en: Hint: stand behind the trolley, grab it with E and push it with W.
hint_trolley_push.zh: 提示：站在推車後面，按E抓住它，再按W推。

hint_trolley_pull.es: Pista: agarra el carrito con E y jálalo con S.
hint_trolley_pull.en: Hint: grab the trolley with E and pull it with S.
hint_trolley_pull.zh: 提示：按E抓住推車，再按S拉。

hint_cabinet.es: Pista: el gabinete está al fondo del almacén, junto a la pared. Ábrelo o ciérralo con E.
hint_cabinet.en: Hint: the cabinet is at the back of the warehouse, against the wall. Open or close it with E.
hint_cabinet.zh: 提示：櫃在倉庫後面，靠著牆。按E打開或關上。

hint_racks.es: Pista: los estantes están al fondo del almacén. La letra está pintada en el piso.
hint_racks.en: Hint: the shelves are at the back of the warehouse. The letter is painted on the floor.
hint_racks.zh: 提示：架在倉庫後面。字母畫在地上。

area_containers.note: Parts of the hall for hints (warehouse_tasks.gd area_of()); zh after 在.

area_racks.en: on the shelves at the back

area_back.en: at the back of the warehouse

area_left_wall.es: junto a la pared, cerca de los recuadros pintados
area_left_wall.en: by the wall, near the painted squares

area_scale.es: cerca de la báscula y la regla
area_scale.en: near the scale and the ruler

area_zones.es: cerca de las zonas de ENTRADA y SALIDA

arrived.note: Toast when the guide arrow reaches its place.

metres.note: Distance left to the guide arrow's place, in metres.

floor_n.note: A building floor; {n} counts from 1 at ground level.

mystery_house.note: The Mystery House (9 Nov 2026), southwest corner by the loop road.

patient_rooms_icu_surgery.zh: 病房、深切治療部與手術室

bakery_cafe.note: Also the slug of 'Bakery / Café' and 'BAKERY / CAFE'.

washingtonstatue.note: The map title made from the node name WashingtonStatue.

everyday.note: Default for a word without a category.

subaru_outback.note: The family car Subi's name card (a car model, not translated).

bruno.note: The airport information pilot, Bruno the bear plush (man) in the pilot outfit. Speaker name and name card.

greeting.es: ¡Hola! Soy el capitán Bruno. Hoy hay muchos vuelos y estoy un poco confundido. ¿Me ayudas a encontrar unos vuelos?
greeting.en: Hi! I'm Captain Bruno. There are lots of flights today and I'm a little confused. Will you help me find some flights?
greeting.zh: 你好！我是布魯諾機長。今天有很多航班，我有點糊塗。你可以幫我找幾班航班嗎？

not_now.es: Ahora no necesito ayuda. ¡Vuelve más tarde!
not_now.en: I don't need help right now. Come back later!
not_now.zh: 我現在不需要幫忙。請稍後再來！
not_now.note: Bruno is not offering the game (data/activities.json chance).

left_early.note: The player left the game early (no completion).

complete.es: ¡Excelente! Encontraste todos los vuelos. ¡Muchas gracias por tu ayuda!
complete.en: Excellent! You found all the flights. Thank you very much for your help!
complete.zh: 太好了！你找到了所有航班。非常感謝你的幫忙！
complete.note: The session reached its progress target (data/activities.json).

time_am.note: A 12-hour time before noon on the board and the clock; {time} is digits (8:30). User decision, 8 Nov 2026: 12-hour times with a.m. / p.m. in every language.

time_pm.note: As time_am, from noon (no flight leaves in the 12 o'clock hour).

calendar_title.note: Over the calendar beside the board: today's month (a month word) and the year in digits.

cal_sun.note: Calendar column heads, Sunday first (user decision, 8 Nov 2026).

again.en: Do you want to play again?
again.note: Bruno after Finish at the end of a completed game, with Yes (flight.play_again) / No (common.reply_no) (user decision, 8 Nov 2026).

tab_departures.note: Board tab (user decision, 8 Nov 2026: departures and arrivals in separate tables, as at an airport; Hong Kong airport wording 離港 / 抵港).

tab_arrivals.note: Board tab: flights arriving from the country.

pick_hint.es: Toca el vuelo correcto en la pantalla.
pick_hint.en: Tap the right flight on the board.
pick_hint.zh: 請在屏幕上點選正確的航班。

browse_hint.es: Aquí están los vuelos de anteayer a pasado mañana.
browse_hint.en: Here are the flights from the day before yesterday to the day after tomorrow.
browse_hint.zh: 這裏是前天到後天的航班。

wrong.es: Mmm, no es ese. Inténtalo otra vez.
wrong.en: Hmm, that's not it. Try again.

leave_confirm.es: ¿Quieres dejar de ayudar al capitán Bruno? No vas a terminar.
leave_confirm.en: Do you want to stop helping Captain Bruno? You won't finish.
leave_confirm.zh: 你想停止幫助布魯諾機長嗎？你不會完成任務。

see_flights.note: Action hint (E) on the flight board and the schedule booklet prop at the information desk (both open the board).

q_which_to_past.es: ¿Cuál es el vuelo a {country} que salió {time}?
q_which_to_past.zh: 哪一班往{country}的航班是{time}出發的？

q_which_to_future.es: ¿Cuál es el vuelo a {country} que sale {time}?

q_which_to_going.es: ¿Cuál es el vuelo a {country} que va a salir {time}?
q_which_to_going.en: Which flight to {country} is going to depart {time}?
q_which_to_going.zh: 哪一班往{country}的航班{time}會出發？

q_find_to_past.es: Busca el vuelo a {country} que salió {time}.
q_find_to_past.en: Find the flight to {country} that departed {time}.
q_find_to_past.zh: 找出{time}已出發、飛往{country}的航班。

q_find_to_future.es: Busca el vuelo a {country} que sale {time}.
q_find_to_future.en: Find the flight to {country} that departs {time}.

q_find_to_going.es: Busca el vuelo a {country} que va a salir {time}.
q_find_to_going.en: Find the flight to {country} that is going to depart {time}.
q_find_to_going.zh: 找出{time}將會出發、飛往{country}的航班。

q_which_going.en: Which flight is going to depart {time}?

q_find_going.es: Busca el vuelo que va a salir {time}.
q_find_going.en: Find the flight that is going to depart {time}.

why_country.es: Ese vuelo va a {country}, no a {wanted}.
why_country.en: That flight goes to {country}, not to {wanted}.

why_past_not.zh: 那班航班是{time}出發的，不是{wanted}。
why_past_not.note: A wrong pick (redesign of 7 Nov 2026): {time} is that flight's own value of the tested time expression (its day, weekday, part of the day, day and clock, or hours from now), {wanted} the asked one.

why_future_not.note: As why_past_not, for a flight that has not departed.

q_which_from_past.es: ¿Cuál es el vuelo de {country} que llegó {time}?
q_which_from_past.zh: 哪一班從{country}來的航班是{time}抵達的？
q_which_from_past.note: Arrival questions (user decision, 8 Nov 2026: llegar): the flight comes FROM the country. As q_which_to_past.

q_which_from_future.es: ¿Cuál es el vuelo de {country} que llega {time}?
q_which_from_future.zh: 哪一班從{country}來的航班{time}抵達？

q_which_from_going.es: ¿Cuál es el vuelo de {country} que va a llegar {time}?
q_which_from_going.en: Which flight from {country} is going to arrive {time}?
q_which_from_going.zh: 哪一班從{country}來的航班{time}會抵達？

q_find_from_past.es: Busca el vuelo de {country} que llegó {time}.
q_find_from_past.en: Find the flight from {country} that arrived {time}.
q_find_from_past.zh: 找出{time}已抵達、從{country}來的航班。

q_find_from_future.es: Busca el vuelo de {country} que llega {time}.
q_find_from_future.en: Find the flight from {country} that arrives {time}.

q_find_from_going.es: Busca el vuelo de {country} que va a llegar {time}.
q_find_from_going.en: Find the flight from {country} that is going to arrive {time}.
q_find_from_going.zh: 找出{time}將會抵達、從{country}來的航班。

q_which_arr_past.note: Arrival questions without a country: used only when the verb is needed (a departure fits the same time expression).

q_which_arr_going.en: Which flight is going to arrive {time}?

q_find_arr_going.es: Busca el vuelo que va a llegar {time}.
q_find_arr_going.en: Find the flight that is going to arrive {time}.

why_country_from.es: Ese vuelo viene de {country}, no de {wanted}.
why_country_from.en: That flight comes from {country}, not from {wanted}.
why_country_from.zh: 那班航班從{country}來，不是從{wanted}來。

why_arrives.en: That flight arrives; it doesn't depart.
why_arrives.zh: 那班航班是抵達的，不是出發的。
why_arrives.note: A wrong pick of the other direction (the landing icon).

why_departs.en: That flight departs; it doesn't arrive.
why_departs.zh: 那班航班是出發的，不是抵達的。
why_departs.note: A wrong pick of the other direction (the take-off icon).

why_past_not_arr.zh: 那班航班是{time}抵達的，不是{wanted}。

review.note: Summary heading (user decision, 8 Nov 2026): the questions missed on the first tap, each as the expression -> what it meant on the board.

review_item.note: {time} is the asked expression, {board} the right flight's day (or date) and time as the board showed it.

on_weekday.note: A weekday on the board other than today (anteayer to pasado mañana, past or future: salió el lunes, sale el viernes).

last_weekday.note: A weekday of last week (Monday-start calendar weeks). Not used by the flight game since 7 Nov 2026; kept for the planned calendar game.

day_clock.note: A day (hoy, mañana, el viernes…) and a clock time.

twinkle.note: The Alta Cocina waiter, Twinkle the beagle plush in the waiter outfit at the host stand. Speaker name.

greeting.es: ¡Hola! Soy Twinkle. Hoy hay muchos clientes. ¿Me ayudas a tomar sus pedidos?
greeting.en: Hi! I'm Twinkle. We have lots of customers today. Will you help me take their orders?
greeting.zh: 你好！我是Twinkle。今天有很多客人。你可以幫我幫客人點菜嗎？

go_to_customer.es: ¡Gracias! Mira si hay clientes que quieren pedir.
go_to_customer.en: Thanks! See if any customers are ready to order.
go_to_customer.zh: 謝謝！去看看有沒有客人想點菜。
go_to_customer.note: Twinkle starts a visit (user, 11 Nov 2026: no customer's name; the customer waiting to order shows the gold '!').

reminder.es: Todavía hay un cliente que quiere pedir. ¡Míralo!
reminder.en: A customer is still waiting to order. Go and see!
reminder.zh: 還有客人等著點菜。快去看看吧！
reminder.note: Talking to Twinkle while a visit is in progress; offers restaurant.stop.

stop.note: Choice on Twinkle's reminder and after a report: asks the leave question.

customer_idle.es: ¡Hola! Estoy esperando al mesero. Habla con Twinkle en la entrada.
customer_idle.en: Hi! I'm waiting for a waiter. Talk to Twinkle at the entrance.
customer_idle.zh: 你好！我在等侍應。去入口跟Twinkle談談吧。
customer_idle.note: A seated customer when no game is running.

customer_wait.en: I'm still looking at the menu.
customer_wait.note: A seated customer who is not the one Twinkle sent the player to.

customer_done.note: The customer after the order was sent.

open_tablet.note: Choice under the customer's order: opens the order tablet.

send.note: Tablet button: sends the chosen dish to the kitchen.

sent.note: Shown on the tablet for a moment before it closes.

close_tablet.note: Tablet and menu book close button.

thanks.note: The customer, right after the order is sent.

verdict_right.en: Excellent! Thank you very much for your help.
verdict_right.zh: 太好了！非常感謝你的幫忙。
verdict_right.note: The customer about two seconds later: the dish was right.

verdict_wrong.es: ¡Oh, no! Esto no es lo que pedí. ¿Puedes intentarlo otra vez?
verdict_wrong.en: Oh no, this is not what I ordered. Can you try again?
verdict_wrong.zh: 哎呀，這不是我點的菜。可以再試一次嗎？
verdict_wrong.note: The customer about two seconds later: at least one dish was wrong. The tablet then opens again (wrong dishes marked) and shows this line in its bubble (24 Nov 2026).

report_right.es: ¡Buen trabajo! {name} recibió justo lo que quería.
report_right.en: Good job! {name} got exactly what they wanted.
report_right.zh: 做得好！{name}得到了想要的菜。
report_right.note: Twinkle when the player comes back after a right dish.

report_wrong.note: Twinkle after a wrong order: {misses} is restaurant.miss_first (and restaurant.miss_also for more wrong dishes, joined by restaurant.sentences).

report_retry.es: {name} recibió lo que quería al final. ¡La próxima vez, intenta acertar a la primera!
report_retry.en: {name} got what they wanted in the end. Next time, try to get it right the first time!
report_retry.zh: {name}最後得到了想要的菜。下次試試一次就點對吧！
report_retry.note: Twinkle after an order that was sent back and then fixed: it does not count towards the target (24 Nov 2026).

report_last.es: ¡Buen trabajo! {name} recibió justo lo que quería. ¡Terminamos por hoy, muchas gracias!
report_last.en: Good job! {name} got exactly what they wanted. That's all for today, thank you so much!
report_last.zh: 做得好！{name}得到了想要的菜。今天的工作完成了，非常感謝你！
report_last.note: Twinkle's report when it reaches the progress target (data/activities.json restaurant_twinkle); offers restaurant.see_words.

miss_first.note: One wrong dish in Twinkle's report: {want} is the requirement it missed (a restaurant.f_* fragment or an ingredient's with/without phrase, so Spanish 'algo' keeps masculine adjectives), {dish} the served dish's word with its article.

miss_also.es: También quería algo {want}, pero le serviste {dish}.
miss_also.en: They also wanted something {want}, but you served {dish}.
miss_also.note: A second or third wrong dish in the same report. Same placeholders in every language (16 Nov 2026: the Chinese line named {name} again).

sentences.note: Two sentences one after the other (orders of several courses, several wrong dishes).

order_intro.note: The customer's first line (11 Nov 2026): the courses wanted, restaurant.item_* joined with restaurant.and / list3; about two seconds later the requests follow.

choose.note: Tablet: puts the dish on the order for its course.

pick_course.es: Elige un plato para cada parte del pedido.
pick_course.en: Choose a dish for each part of the order.
pick_course.note: Tablet: under the order list until every course has a dish.

leave_door.es: ¿Quieres salir del restaurante? Vas a dejar de servir.
leave_door.en: Do you want to leave the restaurant? You'll stop serving.
leave_door.zh: 你想離開餐廳嗎？你會停止服務。
leave_door.note: Quit card at the Alta Cocina entrance while a game runs (an invisible wall holds the door until the answer).

see_words.note: Choice after the last report: opens the tablet with the words practised.

turn_hint.es: Toca las cintas o las flechas para pasar las páginas.
turn_hint.en: Tap the ribbons or the arrows to turn the pages.

not_now.es: Ahora todo está tranquilo. ¡Vuelve más tarde!
not_now.en: It's quiet right now. Come back later!
not_now.zh: 現在很清閒。請稍後再來！
not_now.note: Twinkle is not offering the game (data/activities.json chance).

goodbye.en: Thanks for your help! See you soon.

left_early.note: The player left the game early (no completion).

order_starter.en: For a starter, I'd like something {want}.
order_starter.note: {want} is the order's requirements joined with restaurant.and / list3 / but; each requirement is a restaurant.f_* fragment or an ingredient's with_* / without_* phrase. Spanish always says 'algo' (masculine adjectives: algo frío).

order_main.en: For my main course, I'd like something {want}.

f_plain.note: A property word (data/words.json): taste or temperature. Chinese adds 的 (甜的、凍的).

f_not_very.note: Negation: taste 0-2 (no muy picante allows lower levels).

but.note: A negative requirement after the positive ones. Chinese negative fragments already say 不 / 沒有.

pick_hint.en: Tap a dish to look at it.

complete.es: ¡Qué rica comida! Muchas gracias por tu ayuda.
complete.en: What a delicious meal! Thank you so much for your help.
complete.zh: 真好吃！非常感謝你的幫忙。
complete.note: The meal is complete (data/activities.json restaurant_twinkle progress).

leave_confirm.es: ¿Quieres dejar de servir? No vas a terminar.
leave_confirm.en: Do you want to stop serving? You won't finish.
leave_confirm.zh: 你想停止上菜嗎？你不會完成。

rocco.note: The crocodile plush police officer (man) in the lobby by the holding cell; runs the suspect lineup game. Speaker name. zh renamed from 羅哥 (read as "Brother Luo") to 羅高 (user, 9 Nov 2026).

mimi.note: The cat plush police officer (woman) behind the evidence counter; runs the evidence game. Speaker name. zh renamed from 咪咪 (slang in Mandarin) to 米米 (user, 9 Nov 2026).

lineup_greeting.es: ¡Hola! Soy el agente Rocco. Tenemos cinco sospechosos. ¿Me ayudas a encontrar al correcto?
lineup_greeting.en: Hi! I'm Officer Rocco. We have five suspects. Will you help me find the right one?
lineup_greeting.zh: 你好！我是羅高警員。我們有五個疑犯。你可以幫我找出是哪一個嗎？

evidence_greeting.es: ¡Hola! Soy la agente Mimi. Tenemos pruebas nuevas. ¿Me ayudas a examinarlas?
evidence_greeting.en: Hi! I'm Officer Mimi. We have new evidence. Will you help me examine it?
evidence_greeting.zh: 你好！我是米米警員。我們有新的證物。你可以幫我檢查一下嗎？

not_now.es: Ahora no hay casos. ¡Vuelve más tarde!
not_now.en: There are no cases right now. Come back later!
not_now.zh: 現在沒有案件。請稍後再來！
not_now.note: The officer is not offering the game (data/activities.json chance).

left_early.en: That's fine. Come back any time!

lineup_hint.es: Haz clic en el sospechoso correcto.

evidence_hint.es: Usa Apretar, Tocar o Levantar para examinar las pruebas. Luego haz clic en el objeto correcto o elige la respuesta.
evidence_hint.en: Use Squeeze, Touch or Lift to examine the evidence. Then click the right object or choose the answer.
evidence_hint.zh: 用「捏」、「摸」或「舉起」檢查證物，然後點選正確的物件或選擇答案。
evidence_hint.note: Evidence game (redesigned 8 Nov 2026): the three tools each reveal one property pair for every object at once; a click on an object is the answer.

lineup_two.note: A lineup description: two clue fragments (police.s_*). Always masculine (user decision, 6 Nov 2026).

lineup_one.note: One clue fragment, used when a wrong choice is explained.

e_soft.note: Soft as in not hard (the word soft: blando). Evidence clue fragments (8 Nov 2026): e_* is the verb phrase ('is soft'), a_* the bare adjective ('soft'); a key ending _f is the feminine form, used when the object's noun is feminine in that language (words.json forms gender); other languages repeat the same text.

find.note: An evidence find round (8 Nov 2026): one clue fragment (police.e_*, masculine: el objeto). Exactly one object on the table fits.

report.note: An evidence report round: one object (its word, with the article where the language has one) and two bare adjectives (police.a_*, agreeing with the object).

correct_found.note: A solved evidence round names the object and its property (police.e_*, agreeing): 'Mira: la piedra es dura.'

wrong_found.note: A wrong object in a find round: what the chosen object really is (the opposite property), without showing the answer.

wrong_report.es: No. Mira lo que pasa con «{tool}».
wrong_report.note: A wrong answer in a report round; the game then uses that tool on the object by itself.

summary_first_try.note: An evidence summary line for a round solved with the first answer.

tool_squeeze.note: Evidence tool (8 Nov 2026): reveals hard / soft.

choose_first_suspect.es: Primero, haz clic en un sospechoso.

wrong.es: No es este. Revisa esta pista: {clue}
wrong.en: Not this one. Check this clue: {clue}
wrong.zh: 不是這個。再看看這條線索：{clue}
wrong.note: A wrong choice names one clue it does not fit (police.lineup_one / evidence_one), without showing the answer.

summary.note: Heading of the end-of-game list (detective_card.gd show_summary).

summary_suspect.note: One summary line per lineup round: the suspect's spot number and the clue words.

summary_object.note: One summary line per evidence round: the object and the clue words.

lineup_complete.es: ¡Excelente trabajo, detective! Encontraste a todos los sospechosos. ¿Quieres resolver otro caso?
lineup_complete.en: Excellent work, detective! You found every suspect. Do you want to solve another case?
lineup_complete.zh: 做得好，偵探！你找到了所有疑犯。你想再查一個案件嗎？
lineup_complete.note: End of the game, with Yes (police.play) / No (common.reply_no) to play again (user decision, 8 Nov 2026).

evidence_complete.es: ¡Excelente trabajo, detective! Examinaste todas las pruebas. ¿Quieres resolver otro caso?
evidence_complete.en: Excellent work, detective! You examined all the evidence. Do you want to solve another case?
evidence_complete.zh: 做得好，偵探！你檢查了所有證物。你想再查一個案件嗎？

leave_confirm.es: ¿Quieres dejar la investigación? Las rondas no se guardan.
leave_confirm.en: Do you want to stop the investigation? The rounds won't be saved.
leave_confirm.zh: 你想停止調查嗎？這幾輪不會保存。

lana.note: The teacher of the Grammar Classroom, a sheep plush (woman). Speaker name in the dialogue box.

greeting.es: ¡Hola! Soy Lana, la profesora. ¿Quieres participar en la clase de gramática?
greeting.en: Hi! I'm Lana, the teacher. Would you like to join grammar class?
greeting.zh: 你好！我是拉娜，我是老師。你想參加文法課嗎？

not_now.es: La clase empieza más tarde. ¡Vuelve pronto!
not_now.en: Class starts later. Come back soon!
not_now.zh: 課堂稍後才開始。請快點回來！
not_now.note: Lana is not offering the class (data/activities.json chance).

no_class.es: Todavía no hay clase de gramática para este idioma.
no_class.en: There is no grammar class for this language yet.
no_class.zh: 這種語言還沒有文法課。
no_class.note: The language being learned has no file in data/grammar_class/.

intro.es: Lee la pizarra y siéntate en la mesa con la respuesta correcta. Tienes diez segundos.
intro.en: Read the board and sit at the desk with the right answer. You have ten seconds.
intro.zh: 看看白板，然後坐到寫著正確答案的書枱前。你有十秒。
intro.note: Toast right after the fade in at the start of a class.

keep_going.es: ¡Sigue! Siéntate en la mesa con la respuesta correcta.
keep_going.en: Keep going! Sit at the desk with the right answer.
keep_going.zh: 繼續吧！坐到寫著正確答案的書枱前。
keep_going.note: Talking to Lana during a class.

seated.note: Below the large countdown while the player sits at an answer desk.

review_later.en: This question will come back at the end.
review_later.zh: 這題會在最後再出現一次。
review_later.note: Toast after a wrong or missed answer: the question is asked once more at the end of the class.

continue.note: The card's button after a wrong or missed answer: the next question (otherwise it continues after 10 seconds).

hurry.note: Below the large countdown while the player is not at an answer desk.

confirm.note: The on-screen button that submits the desk the player sits at.

no_answer.es: Sin respuesta: siéntate en una mesa para responder ✗
no_answer.en: No answer: sit at a desk to answer ✗
no_answer.zh: 沒有作答：要坐在書枱前才算作答 ✗

final.en: All done! You got {points} out of {total} points.
final.zh: 完成了！滿分 {total} 分，你得到 {points} 分。

finished.en: Good work! Come back any time.

left_early.en: That's fine. See you next class!

mei.note: The host of the mahjong table in front of the home (cat plush); speaker name and word-card name. docs/guides/MAHJONG.md

awoo.note: Mahjong player (samoyed plush). Renamed from Lin (user, 9 Nov 2026); the home's dining-table samoyed is now Sam.

you.note: The player's name in the status line and result.

greeting.es: ¡Hola! Soy Mei. ¿Quieres jugar al mahjong con nosotros?
greeting.en: Hi! I'm Mei. Do you want to play mahjong with us?
greeting.zh: 你好！我是美美。你想和我們打麻雀嗎？

not_now.es: Estamos en medio de una partida. ¡Vuelve más tarde!
not_now.en: We're in the middle of a game. Come back later!
not_now.zh: 我們正在打緊一局。請稍後再來！
not_now.note: Mei is not offering the game (data/activities.json chance).

choose_mode.es: ¿Cómo jugamos? ¿Hace falta un mínimo de tres fan para ganar, o vale cualquier mano?
choose_mode.en: How do we play? Do you need at least three fan to win, or does any hand count?
choose_mode.zh: 我們怎樣玩？要三番起糊，還是雞糊也可以？
choose_mode.note: The mode question after Yes (user decision, 9 Nov 2026).

continue_ask.es: ¿Seguimos con la partida de antes? Llevas {points} puntos.

l1p1_a.es: El mahjong se juega con **136 fichas**. Casi todas son de **tres palos**, numerados del 1 al 9: **caracteres**, **círculos** y **bambú**. El número está en la esquina azul de cada ficha.
l1p1_a.en: Mahjong is played with **136 tiles**. Most of them belong to **three suits**, numbered 1 to 9: **characters**, **dots** and **bamboo**. The number is in the blue corner of every tile.
l1p1_a.zh: 麻雀有 **136 隻牌**。大部分屬於 **三種花色**，由 1 到 9：**萬子**、**筒子** 和 **索子**。每隻牌的數字在藍色的角上。

l1p1_b.es: También hay **fichas de honor**: los cuatro **vientos** (Este, Sur, Oeste, Norte) y los tres **dragones** (rojo, verde y blanco). No tienen número.
l1p1_b.en: There are also **honor tiles**: the four **winds** (East, South, West, North) and the three **dragons** (red, green and white). Honor tiles have no numbers.
l1p1_b.zh: 還有 **字牌**：四隻 **風牌**（東、南、西、北）和三隻 **三元牌**（中、發、白）。字牌沒有數字。

l1p1_c.es: Hay **cuatro copias de cada ficha**. Juegan cuatro personas, y cada una tiene 13 fichas.
l1p1_c.en: There are **four copies of every tile**. Four players sit around the table, and each one holds 13 tiles.
l1p1_c.zh: **每隻牌都有四隻**。四個人圍着枱坐，每人拿 13 隻牌。

l1p2_title.es: La meta: cuatro grupos y una pareja
l1p2_title.en: The goal: four sets and a pair

l1p2_a.es: Para ganar necesitas **14 fichas: cuatro grupos y una pareja**. Una **pareja** son dos fichas iguales.
l1p2_a.en: To win you need **14 tiles: four sets and one pair**. A **pair** is two identical tiles.
l1p2_a.zh: 要食糊，你需要 **14 隻牌：四組牌加一對**。**一對** 就是兩隻一樣的牌。

l1p2_b.es: En tu turno **robas** una ficha de la pared y luego **descartas** una boca arriba delante de ti. Tienes 13 fichas hasta que llega la ficha que completa tu mano.
l1p2_b.en: On your turn you **draw** a tile from the wall, then **discard** one tile face up in front of you. You keep 13 tiles until the tile that completes your hand arrives.
l1p2_b.zh: 輪到你時，先從牌牆 **摸** 一隻牌，再在面前 **打出** 一隻。你一直拿着 13 隻牌，直到摸到令手牌完成的那一隻。

l1p2_c.es: Cuando tus 14 fichas forman cuatro grupos y una pareja, di **«¡Mahjong!»**. Puedes ganar con una ficha que robas tú o con una que otro jugador acaba de descartar.
l1p2_c.en: When your 14 tiles make four sets and a pair, call **"Mahjong!"** You can win with a tile you draw yourself, or with a tile another player has just thrown away.
l1p2_c.zh: 當你的 14 隻牌成為四組加一對，就叫 **「食糊！」**。你可以用自己摸到的牌食糊，也可以用別人剛打出的牌。

l1p3_a.es: Hay tres clases de grupo. **Chow**: tres fichas **seguidas del mismo palo**, como 3-4-5 de bambú. Solo puedes coger la ficha de un chow del **jugador anterior a ti**.
l1p3_a.en: There are three kinds of set. **Chow**: three tiles **in a row in the same suit**, like 3-4-5 bamboo. You can only take a chow tile from the player **just before you**.
l1p3_a.zh: 牌組有三種。**上**：三隻 **同花色而且連續** 的牌，例如三四五索。上牌只可以要 **你上家** 打出的牌。

l1p3_b.es: **Pung**: **tres fichas iguales**, como tres 7 de caracteres. Puedes coger la ficha de un pung de **cualquiera**. **Kong**: **cuatro fichas iguales**. Cuenta como un grupo, así que robas una ficha más.
l1p3_b.en: **Pung**: **three identical tiles**, like three 7 characters. You can take a pung tile from **anyone**. **Kong**: **four identical tiles**. A kong counts as one set, so you draw an extra tile to make up for it.
l1p3_b.zh: **碰**：**三隻一樣的牌**，例如三隻七萬。碰牌可以要 **任何人** 打出的牌。**槓**：**四隻一樣的牌**。一槓只算一組，所以你要多摸一隻牌。

l1p3_c.es: Cuando coges el descarte de otro, enseñas el grupo boca arriba y luego descartas tú. Si dos quieren la misma ficha, **Mahjong** gana a **pung o kong**, que ganan a **chow**. Los honores nunca forman un chow.
l1p3_c.en: When you take another player's discard, you show the set face up on the table. Then it is your turn, and you discard. If two players want the same tile: **Mahjong** beats **pung or kong**, which beats **chow**. Honor tiles can never make a chow.
l1p3_c.zh: 要了別人打出的牌，就把那組牌翻開放在枱上，然後輪到你打牌。如果兩個人要同一隻牌：**食糊** 先過 **碰或槓**，碰槓先過 **上**。字牌不能上。

l2p1_a.es: Cada mano ganadora vale **fan** (番): puntos según lo especial que sea. Una mano normal de grupos mezclados vale 0 fan y se llama **mano de pollo**.
l2p1_a.en: Every winning hand is worth **fan** (番), points for how special the hand is. A plain hand of mixed sets is worth 0 fan, and is called a **chicken hand**.
l2p1_a.zh: 每副食糊的牌都有 **番**，番數表示這副牌有多特別。一副普通的混合牌是 0 番，叫做 **雞糊**。

l2p1_b.es: Suma todo lo que tenga tu mano. Algunas son formas, como todo pungs o un palo con honores. Otras son extras, como un pung de dragón, un pung de tu viento o del viento de la ronda, o ganar con una ficha que robas tú.
l2p1_b.en: Add up everything your hand has. Some are patterns, such as all pungs, or one suit with honors. Some are bonuses, such as a pung of dragons, a pung of your own wind or the round wind, or winning on a tile you drew yourself.
l2p1_b.zh: 把手牌有的番全部加起來。有些是牌型，例如對對糊、混一色。有些是額外的番，例如三元牌的碰、自己的風或圈風的碰，或者自摸。

l2p1_c.es: Antes de empezar se acuerda un **mínimo**. En la mesa de Mei eliges: **al menos 3 fan** o **cualquier fan**.
l2p1_c.en: Before you start, the players agree a **minimum**. At Mei's table you choose: **at least 3 fan**, or **any fan**.
l2p1_c.zh: 開始前大家要先講好 **起糊番數**。在美美的枱，你可以選：**三番起糊**，或者 **任何番數**。

l2p2_a.es: Cuenta cada parte que gana tu mano y súmalas.
l2p2_a.en: Count every part your hand earns, then add them together.
l2p2_a.zh: 數一數你的手牌每一部分有多少番，再加起來。

l2p2_b.es: Algunas manos son tan raras que valen el **máximo** de golpe, por ejemplo los **trece huérfanos** (uno de cada 1, 9 y honor, más uno) o **todo honores**. En la mesa de Mei, las **siete parejas** (siete parejas distintas) también valen el máximo.
l2p2_b.en: Some hands are so rare that they are worth the **maximum** straight away, for example **thirteen orphans** (one of every 1, 9 and honor, plus one more) or **all honors**. At Mei's table, **seven pairs** (seven different pairs) is a house rule worth the maximum too.
l2p2_b.zh: 有些牌太難做，一做成就是 **滿糊**，例如 **十三么**（每隻一、九和字牌各一隻，再加一隻）或 **字一色**。在美美的枱，**七對子**（七對不同的牌）也是滿糊。

l2p2_c.es: El máximo se acuerda antes de jugar. **Suele ser 8 o 10 fan**; en la mesa de Mei es **13**. Ninguna mano vale más que el máximo.
l2p2_c.en: Players agree the maximum before they play. It is **usually 8 or 10 fan**; at Mei's table it is **13**. No hand can score more than the maximum.
l2p2_c.zh: 滿糊的番數要在開始前講好，**通常是 8 或 10 番**；在美美的枱是 **13 番**。沒有牌可以超過滿糊。

l2p3_a.es: Cada jugador empieza la partida con **saldo 0**. Cuando alguien gana, los fan se convierten en puntos con una tabla acordada. Más fan son muchos más puntos. Una mano sin fan paga como **1 fan**.
l2p3_a.en: Every player starts the game with a **balance of 0**. When someone wins, the fan is turned into points using a table the players agree on. More fan means many more points. A hand with no fan pays like **1 fan**.
l2p3_a.zh: 每個人開始時都是 **0 分**。有人食糊，就按照大家講好的表把番數變成分數。番數越多，分數多很多。0 番的牌照 **1 番** 計。

l2p3_b.es: **Ganar con un descarte:** quien tiró la ficha ganadora **paga el doble**. **Ganar robando tú:** pagan los otros tres jugadores.
l2p3_b.en: **Win on a discard:** the player who threw the winning tile **pays double**. **Self-drawn win:** all three other players pay.
l2p3_b.zh: **食別人打出的牌：** 打出那隻牌的人 **付雙倍**。**自摸：** 其他三個人都要付。

l2p3_c.es: Por ejemplo, Bao gana con 3 fan con el descarte de Kiko: Kiko paga 2 × 8 = **16**. Luego Awoo roba su propia ficha ganadora con 4 fan: Mei, Bao y Kiko pagan 16 cada uno, y Awoo gana **48**. Los saldos siempre suman 0.
l2p3_c.en: For example, Bao wins with 3 fan on Kiko's discard: Kiko pays 2 × 8 = **16**. Then Awoo draws her own winning tile with 4 fan: Mei, Bao and Kiko each pay 16, so Awoo gets **48**. The balances always add up to 0.
l2p3_c.zh: 例如阿寶食琪琪打出的牌，有 3 番：琪琪付 2 × 8 = **16**。然後阿嗚自摸 4 番：美美、阿寶和琪琪各付 16，阿嗚得 **48**。大家的分數加起來永遠是 0。

l2p3_d.es: En la mesa de Mei solo contamos fan. Los puntos y saldos son para cuando juegas con amigos.
l2p3_d.en: At Mei's table we only count fan. Points and balances are for when you play with friends.
l2p3_d.zh: 在美美的枱我們只計番。計分是和朋友玩的時候用的。

bag_empty.note: The zoo booth's till (data/shops.json lines) instead of cashier.basket_empty.

empty_first.es: Primero saca la comida de la bolsa
empty_first.en: Take the food out of the bag first
empty_first.zh: 先把袋子裡的食物拿出來

bag_paid.es: Aquí tienes tu bolsa. ¡Dales de comer a los animales!
bag_paid.en: Here's your bag. Go and feed the animals!
bag_paid.zh: 這是你的袋子。去餵動物吧！
bag_paid.note: Said after paying at the zoo booth: the player keeps the bag (data/shops.json paid_line).

greeting.es: ¡Hola! Hay muchas personas en la fila. ¿Me ayudas en la ventanilla dos?
greeting.en: Hi! There are lots of people in line. Can you help me at window two?
greeting.zh: 你好！排隊的人很多。你可以幫我顧二號窗口嗎？
greeting.note: The bear banker at the bank's reception offers the bank teller game (teller_bank, scripts/learning/teller_session.gd, 18 Nov 2026). He speaks tú to the player; customers speak usted to the teller.

not_now.es: Ahora no hay fila. ¡Vuelve más tarde!
not_now.en: There's no line right now. Come back later!
not_now.zh: 現在沒有人排隊，請稍後再來！
not_now.note: The banker is not offering the game (data/activities.json chance).

start.es: ¡Gracias! Mira la pantalla. Después, cuenta el dinero.
start.en: Thanks! Look at the screen. Then count the money.
start.zh: 謝謝！看看螢幕，然後數錢。
start.note: Said by the banker from reception once the player stands behind window 2.

decline.note: The teller's answer when the balance is lower than the request (one customer per session).

count_change.note: Choice for a change customer (no balance check).

panel_request.note: Top of the money screen. {name}: the customer's name.

tray.note: The money screen's tray title (what the teller hands over).

hint_change.note: In the empty tray of a change customer's money screen.

screen_idle.note: The teller monitor before an account is checked (in-world text, foreign language).

wrong_amount.note: A wrong count. {given}: what the tray held; {amount}: the request (both in words; digits in the native line).

change_hundred.es: ¡No, un billete de cien no! Quiero billetes pequeños.
change_hundred.en: No, not a hundred! I want small bills.
change_hundred.zh: 不要一百元！我要小面額的鈔票。
change_hundred.note: A change customer was given a $100 bill back.

decline_wrong.es: ¡Sí tengo dinero! Mire la pantalla otra vez.
decline_wrong.en: I do have money! Look at the screen again.
decline_wrong.zh: 我有錢的！請再看看螢幕。
decline_wrong.note: Declined although the balance was enough.

pay_wrong.en: Wait! Do I have {amount}? Look again.
pay_wrong.note: Count chosen although the balance was too low.

police_wrong.en: But it's me! Look at the photo.
police_wrong.note: An honest customer when the teller calls the police.

impostor_warn.es: ¡Espera! Mira la foto. No es la misma cara. ¡Pulsa el botón rojo!
impostor_warn.en: Wait! Look at the photo. It's not the same face. Press the red button!
impostor_warn.zh: 等等！看看照片。不是同一張臉。按紅色按鈕！
impostor_warn.note: The banker steps in when the teller says 'not enough' to an impostor; names the hidden alarm, the red button on the counter (user, 24 Nov 2026: no 'Call the police' reply).

impostor_thanks.note: An impostor who was paid out (user, 23 Nov 2026): they take the cash and hurry off; then the bank manager comes out.

manager_warn_1.es: ¡Oye! Esa persona no es la de la foto. ¡Le diste el dinero a otra persona!
manager_warn_1.en: Hey! That person isn't the one in the photo. You gave the money to someone else!
manager_warn_1.zh: 喂！那個人不是照片上的人。你把錢給了別人！
manager_warn_1.note: The bank manager (crocodile in a suit, speaker tag 'boss', f; tú to the player) after the first impostor payout in a session (user, 23 Nov 2026).

manager_warn_2.es: Si no es la misma cara, pulsa el botón rojo. Si pasa otra vez, ya no trabajas aquí.
manager_warn_2.en: If it's not the same face, press the red button. If it happens again, you can't work here anymore.
manager_warn_2.zh: 如果不是同一張臉，就按紅色按鈕。如果再發生一次，你就不能在這裏工作了。
manager_warn_2.note: The manager's warning after a paid impostor; names the hidden alarm (24 Nov 2026).

manager_sorry.es: Lo siento. ¡Voy a mirar la foto!
manager_sorry.en: Sorry. I'll look at the photo!
manager_sorry.note: The player's answer to the warning: she walks back to her office and the game goes on.

manager_fired_1.es: ¡Otra vez no! Esa persona tampoco es la de la foto.
manager_fired_1.en: Not again! That person isn't the one in the photo either.
manager_fired_1.zh: 又來了！那個人也不是照片上的人。
manager_fired_1.note: The manager after a second impostor payout in one session: the player is let go.

manager_fired_2.es: Lo siento, ya no trabajas aquí. ¡Adiós!
manager_fired_2.en: I'm sorry, you don't work here anymore. Goodbye!
manager_fired_2.zh: 對不起，你不能再在這裏工作了。再見！

manager_okay.note: The player's answer: the screen fades and the 'let go' results card shows.

officer_excuse.en: Excuse me. Please come with me.
officer_excuse.note: The police officer (beagle in the police costume) reaches the impostor at window 2 (user, 21 Nov 2026).

impostor_what.note: The impostor's answer to the officer.

officer_now.note: The officer again; then both walk out of the bank.

no_funds.es: Lo siento, no tiene fondos suficientes.
no_funds.en: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
no_funds.zh: 對不起，你的戶口結餘不足。
no_funds.note: The teller (the player, close-up) after 'Not enough' on a short account (user, 21 Nov 2026).

you.note: The teller's speaker tag when the profile has no name.

impossible.note: A short customer's answer to no_funds.

plain_ask_1.en: Hi. I'd like to take out {amount}, please.
plain_ask_1.note: A withdrawal with no reason (data/bank_teller.json reason_chance; user, 21 Nov 2026). {amount} in words.

plain_ask_3.en: Hi. Can you give me {amount}, please?

plain_thanks_1.note: The thanks of a customer who gave no reason.

complete.en: Very good! There's no more line. Thank you!
complete.zh: 做得好！沒有人排隊了。謝謝你！

stopped.es: ¡Gracias por tu ayuda! Ahora trabajo yo.
stopped.en: Thanks for your help! Now I'll work.
stopped.zh: 謝謝你的幫忙！現在我來吧。

leave_confirm.en: Do you want to leave the window?

change_ask.es: ¡Hola! Tengo {amount}. Quiero billetes pequeños, por favor.
change_ask.en: Hi! I have {amount}. I want small bills, please.
change_ask.zh: 你好！我有{amount}。我想要小面額的鈔票。
change_ask.note: One customer per session brings whole hundreds to change (data/bank_teller.json change_dollars); the teller pays it back without $100 bills.

change_thanks.en: Thanks! Now I'm buying ice cream.

bike_ask.es: ¡Hola! Quiero {amount}. Quiero comprar una bicicleta nueva.
bike_ask.en: Hi! I want {amount}. I want to buy a new bike.
bike_ask.zh: 你好！我要{amount}。我想買一輛新單車。
bike_ask.note: Customer personas (data/bank_teller.json personas): <persona>_ask, _thanks (paid exactly), _sad (not enough money). First person, usted to the teller, no gendered words (any plush may say them).

bike_thanks.en: Thanks! I'm going to the bike shop!

baker_ask.es: Buenos días. Quiero {amount} para la panadería. ¡Me gustan los pasteles!
baker_ask.en: Good morning. I want {amount} for the bakery. I like cakes!
baker_ask.zh: 早安！我要{amount}去麵包店。我喜歡蛋糕！

baker_thanks.en: Thanks! Tomorrow I'll bring you a cake.
baker_thanks.zh: 謝謝！明天我帶個蛋糕給你。

telescope_ask.es: ¡Hola! Quiero {amount}. Quiero un telescopio para ver la luna.
telescope_ask.en: Hi! I want {amount}. I want a telescope to see the moon.
telescope_ask.zh: 你好！我要{amount}。我想買望遠鏡看月亮。

telescope_thanks.en: Thank you! Tonight I'll see the moon!

beach_ask.es: ¡Hola! Voy a la playa. Quiero {amount}, por favor.
beach_ask.en: Hi! I'm going to the beach. I want {amount}, please.
beach_ask.zh: 你好！我要去海灘。我要{amount}，謝謝。

beach_thanks.en: Perfect! Bye! I'm off to the beach!
beach_thanks.zh: 太好了！再見！我去海灘囉！

guitar_ask.es: Hola. Quiero {amount}, por favor. ¡Quiero una guitarra!
guitar_ask.en: Hi. I want {amount}, please. I want a guitar!
guitar_ask.zh: 你好。我要{amount}，謝謝。我想要一把結他！

guitar_thanks.en: Thanks! I'm going to play music!

goldfish_ask.es: ¡Hola! Quiero {amount}. Mi pez necesita una casa grande.
goldfish_ask.en: Hello! I want {amount}. My fish needs a big home.
goldfish_ask.zh: 你好！我要{amount}。我的魚需要一個大的家。

party_ask.es: ¡Hola! Mañana es el cumpleaños de mi amigo. Quiero {amount}.
party_ask.en: Hi! Tomorrow is my friend's birthday. I want {amount}.
party_ask.zh: 你好！明天是我朋友的生日。我要{amount}。

party_thanks.en: Thanks! We're going to have a party!

garden_ask.es: Buenos días. Quiero {amount}, por favor. Quiero flores para mi jardín.
garden_ask.en: Good morning. I want {amount}, please. I want flowers for my garden.
garden_ask.zh: 早安。我要{amount}，謝謝。我想買花給我的花園。

garden_thanks.es: ¡Muchas gracias! Mañana le traigo una flor.
garden_thanks.en: Thank you so much! Tomorrow I'll bring you a flower.
garden_thanks.zh: 非常感謝！明天我帶一朵花給你。

title.note: Interface text (native language) on the electrical box close-up (scripts/ui/electrical_box_panel.gd; docs/guides/ELECTRICAL_BOX.md).

how_to.es: Arrastra cada cable al conector del mismo color · Esc: salir
how_to.en: Drag each wire to the connector of the same color · Esc: leave
how_to.zh: 把每條電線拖到同一顏色的接頭 · Esc：離開

title.note: The town reveal (the tutorial's cutscene) when the player first steps outside: the title over the town pictures; 'subtitle' under it (tutorial script, user 17 Nov 2026).

tap_skip.es: Haz clic o toca para saltar
tap_skip.note: Small line at the bottom of the town reveal: it can be skipped.

good_morning.en: Good morning! Ready for an adventure?
good_morning.zh: 早安！準備好去冒險了嗎？
good_morning.note: The welcome tutorial (scripts/learning/tutorial.gd, data/tutorial.json; script revised by the user 17 Nov 2026). Every tutorial.* line is in the player's NATIVE language, except the friends' greetings (sunny_hello, leo_hello: the language being learned). ui_* lines show in the instruction strip (scripts/ui/instruction_strip.gd), *_touch twins on a touch screen; hint_* and where_* are BonBon's answers when the player talks to her.

reply_yes.note: The player's answer button to good_morning (17 Nov 2026, user): the line waits for it.

ui_get_up.es: Pulsa E para levantarte de la cama.
ui_get_up.en: Press E to get out of bed.

ui_get_up_touch.es: Toca el botón E para levantarte de la cama.
ui_get_up_touch.en: Tap the E button to get out of bed.
ui_get_up_touch.zh: 點一下 E 按鈕起床。

look_around.en: Come on, have a look around!

ui_look.es: Haz clic y arrastra para mirar a tu alrededor.
ui_look.en: Click and drag to look around.
ui_look.zh: 按住滑鼠拖動，看看四周。

ui_look_touch.es: Desliza un dedo por el lado derecho de la pantalla para mirar a tu alrededor.
ui_look_touch.en: Slide a finger on the right side of the screen to look around.
ui_look_touch.zh: 用手指在螢幕右邊滑動，看看四周。

ui_move.es: Usa W A S D para moverte.
ui_move.en: Use W A S D to move.
ui_move.zh: 用 W A S D 鍵移動。

ui_move_touch.es: Desliza el pulgar por el lado izquierdo de la pantalla para moverte.
ui_move_touch.en: Slide your thumb on the left side of the screen to move.
ui_move_touch.zh: 用拇指在螢幕左邊滑動來移動。

join_me.en: Great! Join me in the living room!

where_chair.en: I'm right here, next to the chair!

meet_friends.en: I want you to meet my friends!
meet_friends.zh: 我想介紹我的朋友給你認識！

help_find.en: Can you help me find them?

ui_find_friends.es: Misión: encuentra a los dos amigos de {name}.
ui_find_friends.note: {name}: the guide (BonBon). The strip adds the count found (1/2).

hint_bathroom.note: Hints when asked (data/tutorial.json find step): general first, then exact; they point to a friend not found yet.

hint_bathroom_door.es: ¿Ves la puerta abierta? ¡Ese es el baño!
hint_bathroom_door.en: See the open door? That's the bathroom!
hint_bathroom_door.zh: 看到那扇開著的門嗎？那就是浴室！

hint_bedroom.es: ¿Ya buscaste en el cuarto junto al baño?
hint_bedroom.en: Have you checked the room next to the bathroom?
hint_bedroom.zh: 你找過浴室旁邊的房間了嗎？

sunny_hello.en: You found me! I'm {name}! Nice to meet you!
sunny_hello.zh: 你找到我了！我是{name}！很高興認識你！
sunny_hello.note: The bathtub friend's greeting, in the language being learned. {name}: the friend (Sunny, or a stand-in when Sunny is the player's avatar).

leo_hello.note: The yellow bedroom friend's greeting, in the language being learned. {name}: the friend (Leo, or a stand-in).

reply_nice.note: The player's answer button to each friend's greeting, in the language being learned (find step 'reply', 17 Nov 2026).

ui_hold_en.es: ¿No lo entiendes? Mantén pulsado el botón {badge} (o la tecla L) para verlo en tu idioma.
ui_hold_en.en: Don't understand? Hold the {badge} button (or the L key) to see it in your language.
ui_hold_en.zh: 看不懂嗎？按住 {badge} 按鈕（或 L 鍵），就能看到你的語言。
ui_hold_en.note: Strip of the EN introduction at the first friend's greeting. {badge}: the EN button's label (the native language's code).

ui_hold_en_touch.es: ¿No lo entiendes? Mantén el dedo en el botón {badge} para verlo en tu idioma.
ui_hold_en_touch.en: Don't understand? Touch and hold the {badge} button to see it in your language.
ui_hold_en_touch.zh: 看不懂嗎？按住 {badge} 按鈕，就能看到你的語言。

found_one.en: Yay! You found one! There's still someone hiding!
found_one.zh: 耶！你找到一個了！還有一個躲著呢！

not_there.es: No creo que mis amigos se escondan ahí.
not_there.en: I don't think my friends would hide there.
not_there.zh: 我覺得我的朋友不會躲在那裡。
not_there.note: The guide, when the player tries a locked door of the house during the hunt (lock step 'remark_line', 17 Nov 2026: every door but the hiding friend's is locked).

not_right_place.en: That's not where we are going right now!
not_right_place.zh: 我們現在不是要去那裡！
not_right_place.note: Flashes when the player tries a door of another building during the market and park acts (lock step 'line', 17 Nov 2026); in the house act the guide says it at a locked door outside the hunt.

lets_go_outside.es: ¡Vamos afuera! ¡Hay muchas cosas más que te quiero enseñar!
lets_go_outside.en: Let's go outside! There's so much more I want to show you!
lets_go_outside.zh: 我們到外面去吧！我還有好多東西想給你看！

where_outside.es: ¡Ve a la puerta principal! ¡Te espero afuera!
where_outside.en: Head to the front door! I'll be waiting outside!
where_outside.zh: 去大門吧！我在外面等你！

picnic.en: What a beautiful day! Let's have a picnic!
picnic.zh: 今天天氣真好！我們去野餐吧！

need_food.es: ¡Sí! ¡Vamos a comprar fruta para el picnic!
need_food.en: Yay! Let's pick up some fruit for our picnic!
need_food.zh: 好耶！我們去買些水果來野餐吧！

this_way.en: Hey! The supermarket is this way!
this_way.note: BonBon, when the player reaches the edge of the supermarket and its parking lot during the shopping trip (confine step).

clerk_hello.zh: 你好！歡迎光臨超級市場！
clerk_hello.note: The tutorial clerk (tutorial_shop.gd), then clerk_basket as the basket is handed over.

get_list.es: ¡Vamos a comprar todo lo de nuestra lista!
get_list.en: Let's get everything on our shopping list!
get_list.zh: 我們把購物清單上的東西都買齊吧！

click_item.es: ¡Haz clic en un producto para ponerlo en tu canasta!
click_item.en: Click on an item to add it to your basket!
click_item.zh: 點一下商品，把它放進購物籃！

click_item_touch.es: ¡Toca un producto para ponerlo en tu canasta!
click_item_touch.en: Tap an item to add it to your basket!
click_item_touch.zh: 輕觸商品，把它放進購物籃！

click_apple.es: ¡Haz clic en la manzana para ponerla en tu canasta!
click_apple.en: Click on the apple to put it in your basket!
click_apple.zh: 點一下蘋果，把它放進購物籃！
click_apple.note: Shown in the apple close-up the first time the player comes near the tutorial's fruit table (tutorial_shop.gd, 20 Nov 2026).

click_apple_touch.es: ¡Toca la manzana para ponerla en tu canasta!
click_apple_touch.en: Tap the apple to put it in your basket!
click_apple_touch.zh: 輕觸蘋果，把它放進購物籃！

hint_fruit.es: ¿Ya buscaste en la sección de frutas?
hint_fruit.en: Have you checked the fruit section?
hint_fruit.note: Shopping hints when asked (data/tutorial.json shop 'hints'): the fruit while any is missing, then the cookies.

hint_fruit_table.es: ¡Mira la mesa de frutas junto a la entrada!
hint_fruit_table.en: Look at the fruit table near the entrance!
hint_fruit_table.zh: 看看入口旁邊的水果桌！

not_on_list.en: Oops! That's not on our shopping list!
not_on_list.zh: 哎呀！這個不在我們的購物清單上！

got_everything_pay.en: Great! We got everything! Let's go pay!
got_everything_pay.zh: 太好了！全部都買齊了！我們去付錢吧！
got_everything_pay.note: One bubble for 2 s in BonBon's close-up once the list is complete (user, 18 Nov 2026).

where_till.es: ¡La caja está junto a la entrada!
where_till.en: The checkout is near the entrance!

pay_first.note: BonBon, when the player walks into the supermarket's doorway before paying (tutorial_shop.gd door guard).

cashier_hello.note: {amount}: the price in the language being learned, without its digits since 18 Nov 2026 (user); the strip says to hold EN (ui_hold_en).

pay_cash.note: The button under the cashier's request: opens the money panel ($1 bills and quarters only).

ui_pay.es: Toca los billetes y las monedas para juntar {amount}.
ui_pay.en: Tap the bills and coins to make {amount}.

cashier_wrong.es: Mmm... eso no es exacto. ¡Inténtalo otra vez!
cashier_wrong.en: Hmm... that's not quite right. Try again!
cashier_wrong.zh: 嗯……好像不太對。再試一次吧！

where_leave_store.es: ¡Listo! Sal de la tienda; te esperamos afuera.
where_leave_store.en: All paid! Walk out of the store. We're waiting outside.
where_leave_store.zh: 付好了！走出商店吧，我們在外面等你。

everyone_ready.en: Everyone ready? Let's go to the park!
everyone_ready.zh: 大家準備好了嗎？我們去公園吧！
everyone_ready.note: One line since 21 Nov 2026 (user; it was two, with to_park).

look_over_there.en: Hey, look over there! What's that?

ui_click_statue.es: Haz clic en la estatua para descubrir una palabra nueva.
ui_click_statue.en: Click the statue to discover a new word.
ui_click_statue.zh: 點一下雕像，發現一個新詞。
ui_click_statue.note: The statue step (user, 13 Nov 2026): the player stands still and only the statue can be clicked.

ui_click_statue_touch.es: Toca la estatua para descubrir una palabra nueva.
ui_click_statue_touch.en: Tap the statue to discover a new word.
ui_click_statue_touch.zh: 輕觸雕像，發現一個新詞。

where_statue.es: ¿Ves la estatua frente a nosotros? ¡Haz clic en ella!
where_statue.en: See the statue in front of us? Click on it!
where_statue.zh: 看到我們前面的雕像嗎？點一下它！

statue_name.en: It's a statue of George Washington!
statue_name.zh: 這是喬治・華盛頓的雕像！

new_word.es: ¡Bien hecho! ¡Acabas de descubrir una palabra nueva!
new_word.en: Nice! You just discovered a new word!
new_word.zh: 太棒了！你剛發現了一個新詞！

journal_intro.es: Cada palabra que descubres se guarda en tu diario. ¡Vamos a verlo!
journal_intro.en: Every word you find goes into your journal. Let's have a look!
journal_intro.zh: 你發現的每個詞都會記在日誌裡，我們來看看吧！
journal_intro.note: One line since 21 Nov 2026 (user; it was two, with take_a_look).

ui_open_journal.es: Pulsa J o haz clic en el botón del libro para abrir tu diario.
ui_open_journal.en: Press J or click the book button to open your journal.
ui_open_journal.zh: 按 J 或點一下書本按鈕，打開日誌。

ui_open_journal_touch.es: Toca el botón del libro para abrir tu diario.
ui_open_journal_touch.en: Tap the book button to open your journal.
ui_open_journal_touch.zh: 輕觸書本按鈕，打開日誌。

where_close_journal.es: Cuando termines de mirar, cierra el diario.
where_close_journal.en: When you're done looking, close the journal.
where_close_journal.zh: 看完以後，把日誌關起來。

picnic_spot.note: The picnic that ends the tutorial (user, 17 Nov 2026: 'Add a simple picnic'; placeholder lines for the user to revise).

goodbye.es: Ahora todo el pueblo es tuyo para explorar. ¡Diviértete!
goodbye.en: The whole town is now yours to explore. Have fun!
goodbye.zh: 現在整個小鎮都任你探索了。玩得開心！

after_guide_1.note: after_*: what the guide (BonBon), Sunny and Leo say, in turn, when the player talks to them at the picnic after the tutorial (tutorial.json 'after'; user, 21 Nov 2026).

after_guide_2.es: ¡Ve a explorar! Yo me quedo aquí un ratito.
after_guide_2.en: Go on, explore! I'll be here for a while.
after_guide_2.zh: 去探險吧！我會在這裡待一會兒。

after_guide_3.es: Todo lo que ves en el pueblo tiene una palabra para aprender.
after_guide_3.en: Everything you see in town has a word to learn.
after_guide_3.zh: 小鎮裡你看到的每樣東西都有一個詞可以學。

after_sunny_1.es: ¡Mmm, podría comer plátanos todo el día!
after_sunny_1.en: Mmm, I could eat bananas all day!
after_sunny_1.zh: 嗯，我可以吃一整天的香蕉！

after_leo_2.es: Estoy llenísimo... bueno, quizás una manzana más.
after_leo_2.en: I'm so full... well, maybe one more apple.
after_leo_2.zh: 我吃不下了……嗯，可能再吃一個蘋果。

after_leo_3.en: Come and say hi any time!
after_leo_3.zh: 隨時回來跟我們打招呼呀！

level.note: Interface text: the picker's level stepper label (progression, game_progress.gd, 18 Nov 2026).

line_library_rosa.es: ¡Ayudaste a Rosa a devolver cada libro a su estante!

line_teller_fired.en: You paid two people who weren't the one in the photo. Always compare the photo with the face! You can try again on your next visit.
line_teller_fired.zh: 你把錢給了兩個不是照片上的人。一定要比較照片和臉！下次來的時候可以再試。

line_shop_supermarket.en: You got everything on the list!

line_warehouse_ramon.zh: 你幫拉蒙把貨物放上了架子！

title_flight_bruno.note: The user's title in all three languages (22 Nov 2026).

line_flight_bruno.es: ¡Ayudaste al capitán Bruno a encontrar los vuelos!
line_flight_bruno.en: You helped Captain Bruno find the flights!
line_flight_bruno.zh: 你幫布魯諾機長找到了航班！

line_restaurant_twinkle.es: ¡Tomaste todos los pedidos en Alta Cocina!
line_restaurant_twinkle.en: You took every order at Alta Cocina!
line_restaurant_twinkle.zh: 你在 Alta Cocina 幫大家點好餐了！

line_lineup_rocco.es: ¡Ayudaste al agente Rocco a identificar al sospechoso!
line_lineup_rocco.en: You helped Officer Rocco identify the suspect!
line_lineup_rocco.zh: 你幫羅高警員認出了疑犯！

title_evidence_mimi.note: The user's title in all three languages (22 Nov 2026).

line_evidence_mimi.es: ¡Ayudaste a la agente Mimi a encontrar las pistas!
line_evidence_mimi.en: You helped Officer Mimi find the clues!
line_evidence_mimi.zh: 你幫米米警員找到了證物！

line_grammar_lana.es: ¡Llegaste a tu pupitre en cada ronda de la clase de Lana!
line_grammar_lana.en: You raced to the right desk in Lana's class!
line_grammar_lana.zh: 你在拉娜的課上找到了自己的位子！

title_mystery_luna.note: The user's title in all three languages (22 Nov 2026).

line_mystery_luna.es: ¡Abriste las puertas misteriosas de Madame Luna!

line_mystery_luna.zh: 你打開了露娜夫人的神秘之門！

title_teller_bank.note: The user's title in all three languages (22 Nov 2026).

line_teller_bank.es: ¡Atendiste a todos los clientes del banco!
line_teller_bank.en: You served every customer at the bank!
line_teller_bank.zh: 你招呼好了銀行的每位客人！

line_feeding_nico.en: You helped Nico feed the hungry animals!
line_feeding_nico.zh: 你幫尼高餵飽了肚子餓的動物！

missions_hint.es: Pequeños trabajos por el pueblo. Hazlos en cualquier orden, o simplemente juega: cada uno tiene su propio premio.
missions_hint.en: Little jobs around town. Do them in any order, or just play: each one has its own reward.
missions_hint.zh: 鎮上嘅小任務。可以隨便次序做，或者淨係玩：每個都有自己嘅獎勵。

stamps_hint.es: Busca una moneda dorada escondida en cada edificio.
stamps_hint.en: Look for a floating gold coin hidden in each building.
stamps_hint.zh: 在每棟建築物裡找找漂浮的金幣。

diary_empty.zh: 暫時未有：出去探索吓啦！

lineup_rocco.es: ¡Ayuda al agente Rocco a atrapar a un sospechoso!
lineup_rocco.en: Help Officer Rocco catch a suspect!
lineup_rocco.note: Mission titles (missions.gd, 21 Nov 2026): one per learning game id of data/activities.json, said like a request from its NPC (user: 'Help Detective Leo catch a suspect!', not 'Complete Police Minigame').

library_rosa.es: ¡Ayuda a Rosa a devolver los libros perdidos!
library_rosa.en: Help Rosa return the missing books!
library_rosa.zh: 幫羅莎放返啲失咗嘅書！

grammar_lana.es: ¡Corre a tu pupitre en la clase de Lana!
grammar_lana.en: Race to your desk in Lana's class!
grammar_lana.zh: 喺拉娜堂上衝返自己個位！

shop_supermarket.en: Do the shopping at the supermarket!

family_dr_li.es: ¡Ayuda a la Dra. Li a conocer a una familia!
family_dr_li.en: Help Dr. Li get to know a family!

warehouse_ramon.es: ¡Ayuda a Ramón a llenar los estantes!

flight_bruno.es: ¡Ayuda al capitán Bruno a encontrar los vuelos!
flight_bruno.en: Help Captain Bruno find the flights!

restaurant_twinkle.es: ¡Toma los pedidos de Twinkle en Alta Cocina!
restaurant_twinkle.en: Take Twinkle's orders at Alta Cocina!
restaurant_twinkle.zh: 喺 Alta Cocina 幫 Twinkle 落單！

evidence_mimi.es: ¡Ayuda a la agente Mimi a encontrar las pistas!
evidence_mimi.en: Help Officer Mimi feel for the clues!

mystery_luna.es: ¡Abre las puertas misteriosas de Madame Luna!
mystery_luna.zh: 打開露娜夫人嘅神秘之門！

teller_bank.es: ¡Ayuda en el banco a atender a los clientes!
teller_bank.en: Help serve the customers at the bank!

feeding_nico.es: ¡Ayuda a Nico a dar de comer a los animales!
feeding_nico.en: Help Nico feed the hungry animals!

lineup_rocco.es: Revisa las pistas y elige a la persona correcta en la comisaría.
lineup_rocco.en: Check the clues and pick the right person at the police station.
lineup_rocco.zh: 睇清楚線索，喺警署揀出啱嘅人。
lineup_rocco.note: The line under each mission title (missions.gd, 21 Nov 2026).

library_rosa.es: Coloca los libros en los estantes correctos de la biblioteca.
library_rosa.en: Sort the books onto the right shelves at the library.
library_rosa.zh: 喺圖書館將書放返啱嘅書架。

grammar_lana.es: Responde rápido en el aula de la escuela.
grammar_lana.en: Answer quickly in the school classroom.
grammar_lana.zh: 喺學校課室快啲答問題。

shop_supermarket.es: Busca todo lo de la lista y paga en la caja.
shop_supermarket.en: Find everything on the list and pay at the till.
shop_supermarket.zh: 搵齊清單上嘅嘢，再去收銀處俾錢。

family_dr_li.es: Descubre quién es quién en la familia, en el hospital.
family_dr_li.en: Work out who's who in the family at the hospital.
family_dr_li.zh: 喺醫院搞清楚邊個係邊個。

warehouse_ramon.es: Pon la mercancía donde Ramón te pida en el almacén.
warehouse_ramon.en: Put the goods where Ramón asks in the warehouse.
warehouse_ramon.zh: 喺倉庫將貨物放去拉蒙講嘅位置。

flight_bruno.es: Lee el panel de salidas del aeropuerto.
flight_bruno.en: Read the departures board at the airport.

restaurant_twinkle.es: Sirve los platos correctos a los clientes.
restaurant_twinkle.en: Serve the right dishes to the guests.

evidence_mimi.es: Encuentra las pruebas escondidas con las manos en la comisaría.
evidence_mimi.en: Find the hidden evidence by touch at the police station.
evidence_mimi.zh: 喺警署用手摸出收埋咗嘅證物。

mystery_luna.es: Elige la puerta correcta para llegar al tesoro.
mystery_luna.en: Pick the right door to reach the treasure.

teller_bank.es: Cuenta bien el dinero en el banco.
teller_bank.en: Count the money right at the bank.

feeding_nico.es: Dale a cada animal la comida que pide Nico en el zoológico.
feeding_nico.en: Feed each animal Nico names at the zoo.
feeding_nico.zh: 喺動物園餵尼高講嘅動物。
