ring_bell.es: Sube a la torre de la capilla

name_tomas.note: The barn farmer (bear plush, man; data/npcs.json tomas). Speaker name.

friend_1.en: Hi! It's good to see you!
friend_1.note: Idle chatter (npc_chatter.gd, data/npcs.json 'chatter'; 23 Nov 2026, user: A1 lines in the world language, EN shows the native line). Group 'friend': the cast, mahjong players, shoppers.

friend_2.es: Hoy hace un día muy bonito.
friend_2.en: It's a really nice day today.

friend_3.en: Do you know the whole town yet?

shop_1.en: Hi! Are you looking for something?

shop_2.en: We have lots of new things today.
shop_2.zh: 今天我們有很多新東西。

shop_3.en: If you need help, I'm here.
shop_3.zh: 如果你需要幫忙，我就在這裡。

shop_4.zh: 你看，每樣東西都很漂亮。

cashier_3.en: You pay here when you're done.

cashier_4.en: Have a good day! Thanks for coming.
cashier_4.zh: 祝你有美好的一天！謝謝光臨。

waiter_2.es: La comida aquí es muy rica.
waiter_2.en: The food here is really good.

waiter_3.en: Do you want to see the menu?

waiter_4.en: There are a lot of people today.

kitchen_2.en: Mmm! It smells really good, right?

kitchen_4.es: La cocina está muy caliente hoy.
kitchen_4.en: The kitchen is very hot today.

police_3.en: If you see something strange, tell me.
police_3.zh: 如果你看到奇怪的事，就告訴我。

bank_1.es: ¡Hola! Este es el banco del pueblo.
bank_1.en: Hi! This is the town bank.

bank_3.es: La caja fuerte está muy bien cerrada.
bank_3.en: The safe is locked up tight.

bank_4.es: Hoy hay mucho trabajo en el banco.
bank_4.en: There's a lot of work at the bank today.

office_1.en: Hi! How can I help you?

office_2.en: I have a lot of papers today.

office_3.es: El teléfono no para de sonar.

office_4.es: Hoy es un buen día para trabajar.
office_4.en: Today is a good day for work.

warehouse_1.en: Hi! Lots of boxes are arriving today.
warehouse_1.zh: 你好！今天有很多箱子送到。

warehouse_2.es: El camión sale en una hora.
warehouse_2.en: The truck leaves in an hour.

warehouse_3.zh: 這裡每樣東西都有它的位置。

warehouse_4.en: It's so hot in the warehouse!

driver_1.en: Hi! I'm waiting for my passengers.

driver_3.es: Me gusta conducir por el pueblo.

hospital_2.es: Bebe mucha agua. Es bueno para ti.
hospital_2.en: Drink lots of water. It's good for you.

hospital_3.en: I have a lot of patients today.

hospital_4.es: Si te duele algo, ven a vernos.
hospital_4.en: If something hurts, come and see us.
hospital_4.zh: 如果哪裡痛，就來找我們。

school_3.es: Leer un poco cada día es muy bueno.
school_3.en: Reading a little every day is very good.

school_4.es: Las palabras nuevas son mis favoritas.

library_1.en: Hi! There are books for everyone here.
library_1.zh: 你好！這裡有適合每個人的書。

library_2.es: Por favor, habla en voz baja.

library_4.es: Hay libros nuevos en el carrito.
library_4.en: There are new books on the cart.

airport_1.en: Hi! There are lots of flights today.

airport_2.es: Me encanta volar sobre el mar.
airport_2.en: I love flying over the sea.

airport_3.es: Mira la pantalla para ver los vuelos.
airport_3.en: Look at the screen to see the flights.

airport_4.es: El cielo está muy bonito hoy.
airport_4.en: The sky is really beautiful today.

mystery_2.es: Veo algo bueno en tu futuro.
mystery_2.en: I see something good in your future.
mystery_2.zh: 我看到你的未來有好事。

mystery_4.es: La bola de cristal duerme ahora.
mystery_4.en: The crystal ball is asleep right now.

farm_1.zh: 你好！我是湯馬士，是這裡的農夫。

farm_2.en: The cows eat a lot of grass.

farm_3.es: Me levanto muy temprano todos los días.
farm_3.en: I get up very early every day.

farm_5.es: El trabajo en la granja es duro, pero me gusta.
farm_5.en: Farm work is hard, but I like it.
farm_5.zh: 農場的工作很辛苦，但我喜歡。

brush_staff_1.es: Si no necesitas nada, puedes mirar tranquilamente.
brush_staff_1.en: If there's nothing I can help with, feel free to look around.
brush_staff_1.zh: 如果沒有甚麼需要幫忙，你可以隨便看看。
brush_staff_1.note: Brush-off when the player keeps prompting the same NPC (npc_chatter.gd, 23 Nov 2026, user).

brush_staff_2.en: Sorry, I'm a bit busy right now.
brush_staff_2.zh: 不好意思，我現在有點忙。

brush_staff_3.es: Hablamos luego, ¿vale? Tengo cosas que hacer.
brush_staff_3.en: Let's talk later, OK? I have things to do.
brush_staff_3.zh: 我們晚點再聊，好嗎？我有事要做。

brush_friend_1.note: Brush-off of friends and customers when the player keeps prompting them (npc_chatter.gd).

brush_friend_2.en: I want to rest a little now.

brush_friend_3.en: Go and explore! See you later.
